title: New game I'm working on - 100% AI, new VFX & Animations
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hello everyone,

  
I posted my previous D2 ARPG game here - I've now started working on a new game that is FPS/Third person and wave-based, with really smooth animations and spell VFX

This is how far I've come so far after about a days work - looking for ideas how to make some more interesting mechanics in the game

Really happy with the animations and UI so far, but would love any feedback!  


This was built without any coding from my end, so 100% built with prompts only

comments.author: BeginningSome2182
comments.body:
This would have slapped hard in 1999-2006

Crazy that this is 100% AI built with prompts.

Well done.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Thanks! It’s a bit rough around the edges but spell VXF has the 2000’s vibe

comments.body: Finally some 3d stuff on this sub

2d feels largely solved but working 3D is more animation heavy

replies.author: Nightman2417
replies.body: This is where I hesitate to start trying AI game developing. Don’t some engines have built in or included animations for basic characters? Like generic running and whatnot

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yep! But you can edit freely inside Tesana (there is an animation editor) and code export/editing so you’re not locked in

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Posted the name in earlier comments - happy to share the link in a DM

replies.author: teamharder
replies.body: So just Tesana? Is it even possible to scale to a marketable game within that platform?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Yeah, 

As for how far you can take the game - probably not triple A but definately a polished indie game is possible. Still requires some work on the prompting side and will take you a few weeks for a commercially ready game depending on polished you’re going for

You can also export the code or work with the code inside Tesana

replies.author: teamharder
replies.body: What's the furthest you've gotten with this engine? I'm working on my 3rd vibe coded game with Unity and it definitely takes more than a few weeks for a decently polished game.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
I have a few completed games that I put on itch - nothing has taken more than 2-3 weeks for me, but they’re not massive games by any means

Story based RPGs or platformers mostly 

Tesana also has storefront feature so you can list and sell the game once it’s ready

comments.author: Larogoth
comments.body: any tips for Tesana? I signed up for the $20 pro version and attempted to make a game twice. first one wouldn't load any character models, second one wouldn't load the screen or characters or anything but a gray screen.

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Join the discord and write in the support chat - the team replies instantly usually and will help you with any issues :)
